name: llama-4-maverick-17b-128e
description: meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct as its Hugging Face config.json (main). The official repository is gated (HTTP 401 without a token); the file here is the byte-identical public mirror unsloth/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct, sha256 recorded. The campaign's `llama4` workload variant. Decoder fields come from text_config (multimodal wrapper).

attention.notes: K and V, bf16: 2 x 8 kv heads x 128 x 2 B = 4096 B per layer per token; 48 layers = 196,608 B per token. Chunked local attention on 3 of every 4 layers (attention_chunk_size 8192) is not modelled: full-context KV is the upper bound.

moe.notes: interleave_moe_layer_step 2: odd layers are MoE (24 of 48), even layers dense with intermediate_size_mlp 16384; per-expert width is text_config.intermediate_size (8192); top-1 routing; each MoE layer also has one shared expert (HF Llama4TextMoe.shared_expert, not a config.json field).
